user.title: Connect a network to a zone
user.description: Select an existing network integration and an active geographic zone. Setup leaves existing trackers unchanged; eligible new client trackers receive this zone.

error.invalid_source: Choose an existing UniFi Network or MikroTik Router entry.
error.invalid_zone: Choose an existing active zone; passive zones are not supported.

abort.already_configured: This source already has a zone rule.

change_zone.title: Change target zone
change_zone.description: Choose the new zone. The next screen previews every currently managed tracker that would change; nothing is written yet.

confirm_zone_change.title: Confirm target zone change
confirm_zone_change.description: Change this rule to {target}? {count} previously managed tracker(s) qualify. All are selected by default. Clear a tracker to keep its current zone; it will stop following this rule until you select it in a later zone change or explicitly repair it. Pre-existing trackers remain unchanged.

data.preview: No previously managed trackers will change
data.confirm: I have reviewed this change and want to apply it

audit.title: Review mismatched tracker zones
audit.description: Found {count} trackers whose associated zone differs from {target}. All are selected by default; clear any that should keep their current zone. This review makes no changes.

confirm.title: Apply zone to existing trackers?

data.confirm: I have reviewed this repair and want to apply it

error.invalid_source: The selected source integration no longer exists.
error.invalid_zone: Choose an existing active zone; passive zones are not supported.
error.invalid_selection: Select at least one listed tracker.
error.preview_modified: The preview was modified. Leave it unchanged and review the action again.
error.confirmation_required: Check the confirmation box to continue.

abort.rule_unavailable: The rule is not loaded. Try again after the integration is ready.
abort.zone_unchanged: The selected zone is already the rule's target.
abort.zone_preview_stale: The rule or its trackers changed after the preview. Review the zone change again.
abort.no_trackers: No eligible client trackers were found for this source. Check that its integration has created client connection trackers.
abort.no_mismatches: All eligible trackers already match the target zone.
